tagline: Building stockholder value through returns-focused development of natural gas, NGLs and oil properties
hero_kpi_rationale: The company's primary driver is controlled growth in natural gas production, supported by a portfolio of high-return projects in the Marcellus basin.

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.explanation: Money earned from the sale of natural gas, oil and natural gas liquids.
kpis.description: Revenue increased 27% in 2025 driven by higher realized prices (+24%) and modest production growth (+2%). Exact amount: $2,815,591 thousand.
kpis.signal: Strong growth driven by prices and volumes

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.explanation: Profit after all expenses and taxes.
kpis.description: Net income reached $658.0 million in 2025 compared to $266.3 million in 2024, up 147%, driven by higher realized prices and slightly higher production.
kpis.signal: Net income doubling thanks to natural gas prices

kpis.name: Average Daily Production (gas equivalent)
kpis.explanation: Average daily quantity of gas, oil and NGLs produced, converted to gas equivalent.
kpis.description: Average daily production reached 2.24 billion cubic feet equivalent gas (Bcfe) in 2025, up 2.5% from 2024 (2.18 Bcfe).

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures
kpis.explanation: Spending to develop wells and infrastructure.
kpis.description: 2025 CAPEX was $673.8 million, within the guided range of $650 to $690 million, with focus on high-return projects.

kpis.name: Free Cash Flow
kpis.description: Estimated at approximately $526 million ($1.2 billion operating cash flow less $674 million CAPEX), significantly higher than 2024, reflecting the combination of higher prices and increased production.
kpis.signal: FCF doubling thanks to operating efficiency

kpis.name: Dividend per Share
kpis.explanation: Amount paid to shareholders per share each year.
kpis.description: Annual dividend was raised to $0.36 per share in 2025 from $0.32 in 2024, reflecting confidence in sustainable cash flow generation.
kpis.signal: Dividend increase despite commodity price volatility

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of $7.42 billion in latest year

kpis.name: Total Debt
kpis.description: Total debt extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total debt of $1.37 billion in latest year

kpis.name: Dividend per Share
kpis.description: Dividend per share paid annually, aggregated from yfinance.dividends over the last 7 declared fiscal years by the company.
kpis.signal: Dividend per share of $0.10 in latest year

kpis.name: Capital Returned (dividends)
kpis.description: Capital returned to shareholders via annual dividends, extracted from yfinance.cashflow over the last 4 declared fiscal years.
kpis.signal: Capital returned to shareholders via dividends of $0.086 billion in latest year

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.description: Payout ratio: Dividends paid / Net income, calculated over the last 4 fiscal years from yfinance.cashflow and yfinance.income_stmt.
kpis.signal: Share of net income distributed as dividends: 13.0% in latest year

kpis.name: Natural Gas Price Realization
kpis.explanation: Average NYMEX price realized for natural gas sold.
kpis.description: Average NYMEX natural gas price realized in 2025 reached $3.43/mcf versus $2.27/mcf in 2024, driven by increased LNG exports and reduced global supply.
kpis.signal: Strong rebound in natural gas prices in 2025

kpis.name: Oil Price Realization
kpis.explanation: Average NYMEX price realized for barrels of oil sold.
kpis.description: Average NYMEX oil price declined to $64.52/barrel in 2025 from $76.17 in 2024, in a context of global overproduction.

kpis.name: Operating Cash Flow
kpis.explanation: Cash generated from operating activities before investments.
kpis.description: The company generated $1.2 billion in operating cash flow in 2025, up $226.8 million from 2024, reflecting higher realized prices and increased production volumes.
kpis.signal: Robust cash generation supported by elevated prices

risks.title: Commodity price volatility
risks.score_rationale: The risk is highlighted multiple times throughout the document, notably in the 'Market Conditions' and 'Overview of Our Business' sections, with strong language emphasizing direct impact on revenues, cash flow, reserves and ability to raise capital. It is considered fundamental to RRC's business model. The Macro category carries significant weighting.

risks.title: Litigation and regulatory claims
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned in the 'Legal Proceedings' section, with acknowledgment of multiple ongoing actions (royalties, contracts, environment). While the company asserts the impact will not be material, the risk of penalties >$250,000 is explicitly cited, indicating non-negligible exposure.

risks.title: Environmental risks and penalties
risks.score_rationale: The 'Environmental Proceedings' section indicates violation notices are received regularly. The risk of penalties >$250,000 is noted, with cautious language ('cannot predict with certainty'). Environmental regulation is a major issue for gas producers, raising severity.

risks.title: Dependence on hedging derivatives
risks.score_rationale: The company partially relies on derivatives to mitigate price volatility, as indicated in 'Outlook for 2026'. Poor management or counterparty default could expose the company to material losses, especially in heightened volatility contexts.

risks.title: Competition for infrastructure access
risks.score_rationale: In 'Market Conditions', the company mentions infrastructure constraints as a limiting factor for natural gas growth. This affects the ability to export and realize optimal prices, a strategic issue in production basins.

risks.title: Dependence on permit consolidation strategy
risks.score_rationale: The company invests in permit renewal and consolidation in Pennsylvania ($51.8 million in 2025). Difficulty maintaining or extending these positions could limit future development, although this is being actively managed.

ai_positioning.summary: RRC does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K report. The information provided focuses on the company's financial aspects, natural gas reserves and operations.
